rules.overlap: At most 2 courses (and at most 6 units) of the minor requirement may be met by mandatory courses of the student's degree(s) (GIR excluding Humanities, or discipline core). No course may count toward two minors, or toward two majors and a minor.
rules.project_limit: At most one project/seminar type course may be used for a minor.
rules.gpa: Cumulative GPA of 4.5 or above (out of 10) in the courses applied to the minor.
rules.declaration: Declared at the end of the 2nd year.
